verdict.rationale: Undermind documents workspace upload: paywalled PDFs 'can be read after workspace upload'. Its search tool can target 'papers already in the workspace', and it reads full-text PDFs in parallel to answer questions across many papers. Unlimited files and paper libraries are listed. However, upload appears only as a side note about paywalled papers, not as a first-class corpus-ingestion feature. Missing for 10: explicit support for uploading an arbitrary personal corpus (non-paper documents, bulk ingestion), evidence that the deep-research agent can be scoped to only the user's uploaded corpus, detailed upload docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
